steps: Initialize the printed five-part profile with the Organ configured as three staves.
Use the frozen source map for every physical system and the already reviewed examples; accept only the two supported suggestions, then explicitly assign the eight unresolved systems.
Use each frozen printed-anchor/barline count for absent-part rows. Keep the seven opening vocal rest staves as original music; never copy a count from a template.

Apply through the native document workflow, save a source-embedded project, export all five complete parts, reopen, and verify all 70 original item references cover bars 1–102 without missing or duplicate intervals.
Review all generated output against all six original pages, focusing on lyrics, manual/pedal identity, low ties, registration marks, absent-part rest timing and page turns.
limitations: No complete Mendelssohn output is claimed or created by this recommendation.
